items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:61:1
items.html: The Nukva can bear the light of the male only from his VAK: And this is because of the light of Hochma that remained in the Rosh beneath Malchut, since its posterior is downward, and it withholds the illumination of GAR from the Keter of the Guf (as above in the Inner Light, page 324, the passage beginning “and this must be understood,” study it there well). And there this was explained with regard to the Partzuf of Hochma; and the same holds in the Partzuf of Bina, for one and the same reason applies to both, namely because of the light that remained in the Rosh and cannot expand to the Guf of itself. For although its record illuminates in the Guf, such an illumination is nevertheless discerned as being by way of the posterior, which withholds the illumination of GAR. And this is what he says, the Nukva can bear the light of the male only from his VAK.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 5:61:2
items.html: And from the coupling of these ZON, who were included in the simple letter Yod, there emerge from them two sons like themselves, ZON, and they are the secret of the Vav and the Dalet of the filling of Yod. The explanation is that, just as the ZON of Keter that are in the Partzuf of Hochma of AK emanated the ZON to the vessel of Hochma of that Partzuf, so the ZON of Keter that are in the Partzuf of Bina here likewise brought out, through their coupling together, the ZON to the vessel of Hochma here. Except that the difference is in the measure of the level: for in the Partzuf of Hochma the ZON of the vessel of Hochma are discerned as the aspect of YH, as above in the words of the ARI (page 350, item 53, study it there well); but here, where even in the ZON of Keter there is nothing but the aspect of the light of Bina, therefore in the ZON of Hochma that were emanated through their coupling there is already no aspect of GAR, but only the aspect of the VAK of GAR — for it is like the ZON of the vessel of Bina that were emanated from the ZON of Hochma in the Partzuf of Hochma of AK, since the level of the ZON of Keter of the Partzuf of Bina is equal to the level of the ZON of Hochma in the Partzuf of Hochma of AK, as written at length in the Inner Light above (page 341, the passage beginning “and now,” study it there well). And therefore the male that is in the vessel of Hochma here is not called by the name Yod but Vav, for the VAK is always called by the name Vav. And this is what he says, that they are the secret of the Vav and the Dalet of the filling of Yod — which is like the ZON that are in Bina of the Partzuf of Hochma.
